title: Extract Finance leaf owners and isolate Replit database tests
statusReason: Net-worth, AI parsing/insight, notification, and receipt-token implementations now have canonical Finance owners with compatibility re-exports. Their consumers were rewired and the finance boundary scan, API typecheck/build, domain tests, and isolated Replit database tests passed. The wider target tree and money-critical cutover gates remain incomplete.

commit.workingTreeAtStart: Clean except for the two user-provided attached plans; implementation and generated validation evidence are uncommitted.

objective: Move existing low-risk Finance leaf implementations into their target owners without changing HTTP contracts, database schema, money calculations, or provider behavior; run DB-backed checks in a disposable isolated schema on Replit's development database.

oldToNewMapping.compatibility: The old path re-exports the functions; the Finance route, net-worth job, and notification owner import the new owner.
The old path re-exports the API; Finance routes import the new owner.
The old path re-exports the API; Finance routes and the daily digest job import the new owner.
The accounting library re-exports the old symbols; the Finance route and notification owner import the new owner.

databaseTestIsolation.target: Replit-managed development database selected with DATABASE_URL_TARGET=replit-test.
databaseTestIsolation.schema: Each run creates a uniquely named finance_test_* schema, applies only allowlisted Finance table/create-index/add-column DDL, uses that schema alone as search_path, and drops it in finally.

commands.result: Workspace dependencies installed from the existing lockfile; no dependency versions changed.

invariants.journalDebitCreditBalance: PASS for the controlled balanced-journal fixture.
invariants.concurrentPrincipalDecrements: PASS for two controlled concurrent repayments.
invariants.netWorthCurrencyConversionAndOwnershipSh: PASS for one controlled multi-currency/partial-ownership fixture.
invariants.receiptTokenIdempotencyAndOwnerScope: PASS for a controlled entry fixture.
invariants.quickEntryParsing: PASS for compound input and USD/INR SMS cases.

runtimeVerification.result: API and web builds completed, but the API process exits because APP_DATABASE_URL is not configured. The Replit test database was not used as the application database.

limitations: This is a leaf-module extraction tranche, not completion of the full proposed Finance tree.
Application use cases and all 109 Finance handlers remain in the route files; ledger, schedule, invoice, payment-method, wallet-bridge, late-fee, and cron owners still need extraction.
No schema migration or service cutover was performed.
No full app preview was available because the required APP_DATABASE_URL is absent.
diffReview: Moved existing implementations and changed only import paths/compatibility exports, except for the test runner and tests. The notification module retains its pre-existing dependency on routes/notifications. No Finance endpoint, event contract, schema, authorization rule, money formula, rounding, or provider behavior was changed.
nextSafeStep: Add isolated database-backed rollback, retry/idempotency, and authenticated route-authorization tests, then extract the read-only Finance report use cases before gated ledger and invoice moves.
